summary: PostgreSQL deployment migrations, separate from historical D1 schema. No foreign keys. Apply versioned SQL once through a migration runner; covers admission, tokens, replication log/outbox, checkpoints and batch idempotency.

key_files.0001_project_admission.sql: Tenant, membership, project and admission tables with PostgreSQL timestamps.
key_files.0002_api_tokens.sql: Node control-plane API-token hash authority; no browser sessions or identity provider integration.
key_files.0003_replica_log.sql: Per-project committed cursors, binary updates and a lease-based PG outbox queue. Durable replay retained independently of notification acknowledgement.
key_files.0004_replica_checkpoint.sql: Full Loro binary snapshot plus covered durable cursor. Independent of notification queue lifecycle; retention remains deferred.
key_files.0005_replica_batch.sql: Project/batch payload fingerprint for atomic protocol retries; retained with event history.
key_files.0012_project_resources.sql: Project-scoped immutable Resource registry; admitted with Loro Asset facts in one PG transaction, no foreign keys or duplicate Asset lifecycle.
